akamaiSecurityRestrictions.description: The App & API Protector security restrictions that you apply to an API. Note that you should only include these details in your requests if you're a App & API Protector customer.

ALLOW_ONLY_SPEC_UNDEFINED_METHODS.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources, but only for specific methods. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_BODY_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows for requests with undefined parameters in body. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_COOKIE_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows for requests with undefined parameters in cookies. These booleans override fields in the Method object. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_HEADER_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows for requests with undefined parameters in header. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_DELETE.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the DELETE method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_GET.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the GET method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_HEAD.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources using HEAD method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_OPTIONS.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources using OPTIONS method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_PATCH.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources using PATCH method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_POST.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the POST method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_PUT.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the PUT method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows requesting with undefined parameters. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_QUERY_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows for requests with undefined parameters in query string. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_RESOURCES.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_SPEC_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources, but only for specific locations. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

MAX_BODY_SIZE.description: The maximum allowed size of a request body.

MAX_DOC_DEPTH.description: The maximum depth of nested data elements allowed in a request body.

MAX_ELEMENT_NAME_LENGTH.description: The maximum length of an XML element name or JSON object key name allowed in a request body.

MAX_INTEGER_VALUE.description: The maximum integer value allowed in a request body.

MAX_JSONXML_ELEMENT.description: The maximum number of XML elements, JSON object keys, or array items allowed in a request body.

MAX_STRING_LENGTH.description: The maximum length of any string value in a request body.

POSITIVE_SECURITY_ENABLED.description: Whether to enforce the API request body and resource constraints as allowlists in your App & API Protector security policies. Either `1` for enabled security constraints, or `0` for disabled.

POSITIVE_SECURITY_VERSION.description: Whether to create the API with API Protection 2 or above. Either `1`, `2` for enabled API Protection 2, or `null` for the legacy API.

RESPONSE_RESTRICTIONS_ENABLED.description: When set to `1`, the API allows for responses with undefined parameters in the response body. Otherwise the value is `0`.

apiCategoryIds.description: The category identifiers that apply to the endpoint. The value is `null` for uncategorized endpoints.

apiEndPointHosts.description: The hostnames that may receive traffic for the endpoint. You need at least one hostname before activating the endpoint.

apiEndPointId.description: __Read-only__ The unique identifier for the endpoint.

apiEndPointLocked.description: __Read-only__ Whether the endpoint version is read-only.

apiEndPointName.description: The name of the endpoint, unique within the account.

apiEndPointScheme.description: The URL scheme to which the endpoint may respond, either `http`, `https`, or `http/https` for both.

apiEndPointVersion.description: __Read-only__ The unique identifier for the endpoint version.

apiGatewayEnabled.description: Whether the API Gateway product should be enabled for the endpoint. If `null`, the field is set to `true`.

apiSource.description: Specifies if the API's data comes from `API_DISCOVERY` or was provided by the `USER`.

apiVersionInfo.description: A major API version. This refers to REST API versioning and is a different concept than the endpoint configuration versions you create at Akamai.

location.description: The location of the API version value in an incoming request. Either `HEADER`, `BASE_PATH`, or `QUERY` parameter.

parameterName.description: The name of the header or query parameter that includes the API version value. This is applicable only if the corresponding `location` field is either `HEADER` or `QUERY`.

value.description: The expected API version value in an incoming request.

availableActions.description: __Read-only__ Available actions that you can perform on the endpoint depending on its versions' activation status. For possible values, see [Endpoint.availableActions values](#enumvalues2).

basePath.description: The URL path that serves as a root prefix for all resources' `resourcePath` values. This is `/` if empty. Don't append a `/` character to the path. If you specify `null` in the request or omit this field from the object, the JSON response reflects it as an empty string.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the URLs and parameters within the endpoint are case sensitive.

clonedFromVersion.description: __Read-only__ For cloned endpoints, the unique identifier for the source endpoint version.

consumeType.description: The content type the endpoint exchanges, either `json`, `xml`, `urlencoded`, `json/xml/urlencoded`, `json/urlencoded`, `json/xml`, or `xml/urlencoded` for multi-format APIs, `any`, or `none`. A `null` value is the same as a `none` string.

contractId.description: __Read-only__ The unique identifier for the contract with Akamai under which you provisioned security and delivery settings for this API.

createDate.description: __Read-only__ The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when you created the endpoint.

createdBy.description: __Read-only__ The identifier for the user who created the endpoint.

description.description: The description of the endpoint. If you specify `null` in the request or omit this field from the object, the JSON response reflects it as an empty string.

discoveredPiiIds.description: Personally identifiable information (PII) in your API parameters discovered by the network.

endpointHidden.description: __Read-only__ Specifies whether the endpoint is hidden. You cannot activate or delete versions of a hidden endpoint. If you want to do so, you first need to reveal the endpoint by running the [Show an endpoint](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-definitions/reference/post-endpoint-show) operation.

groupId.description: __Read-only__ The unique identifier for the group in Control Center under which you provisioned security and delivery settings for this API.

isGraphQL.description: Whether the endpoint uses GraphQL to deliver structured content to clients.

lockVersion.description: __Read-only__ The identifier for the last modification of an endpoint version, used for optimistic locking. See [Concurrency control](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-definitions/reference/concurrency-control) for details.

matchPathSegmentParam.description: Whether or not to include path segment parameters in match criteria, like the `jsessionid` portion of `/ssocookie;jsessionid=434343`.

positiveConstrainsEnabled.description: Specifies whether the App & API Protector firewall policies are enabled for the endpoint.

productionStatus.description: __Read-only__ The version activation status on the production network, either `PENDING` if the version contains changes that are being propagated to the network, `ACTIVE` if the version is active, `DEACTIVATED` if the version was once active but is now inactive, or `FAILED` if an activation or deactivation attempt for this version has failed. The value is `null` for versions that have never been activated on this network.

To POST JSON data, see [Make a JSON request to register an endpoint from an API definition file](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-definitions/reference/endpoint-request-json). To make a form request using these parameters, see [Make a form request to register an endpoint from an API definition file](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-definitions/reference/endpoint-request-form).

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_PUT.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the PUT method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

lockVersion.description: __Read-only__ The identifier for the last modification of an endpoint version, used for optimistic locking. See [Concurrency control](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-definitions/reference/concurrency-control) for details.

matchPathSegmentParam.description: Whether or not to include path segment parameters in match criteria, like the `jsessionid` portion of `/ssocookie;jsessionid=434343`.

positiveConstrainsEnabled.description: Specifies whether the App & API Protector firewall policies are enabled for the endpoint.

productionStatus.description: __Read-only__ The version activation status on the production network, either `PENDING` if the version contains changes that are being propagated to the network, `ACTIVE` if the version is active, `DEACTIVATED` if the version was once active but is now inactive, or `FAILED` if an activation or deactivation attempt for this version has failed. The value is `null` for versions that have never been activated on this network.

productionVersion.description: __Read-only__ An endpoint version's activation status on the production network.

lastError.description: The last failed activation of the endpoint version.

status.description: __Read-only__ The activation status on the production network, either `PENDING` if the version contains changes that are being propagated to the network, `ACTIVE` if the version is active, `DEACTIVATED` if the version had been active once but has been deactivated, or `FAILED` if an activation or deactivation attempt for this version has failed. The value is `null` for versions that have never been activated on this network.

timestamp.description: __Read-only__ The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating the last update of the activation status.

status.description: __Read-only__ The activation status on the production network, either `PENDING` if the version contains changes that are being propagated to the network, `ACTIVE` if the version is active, `DEACTIVATED` if the version had been active once but has been deactivated, or `FAILED` if an activation or deactivation attempt for this version has failed. timestamp.description: __Read-only__ The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating the last update of the activation status.

protectedByApiKey.description: __Read-only__ Whether you enabled API key protection for the endpoint version by making the version private.

responseConstraintsEnabled.description: __Read-only__ Specifies whether response constraints are enforced for the endpoint. Note that if you enable response constraints but don't define the constraints, it behaves as if disabled.

securityScheme.description: The key with which users may access the endpoint.

securitySchemeDetail.description: The location of the API key.

apiKeyLocation.description: The location of the API key in incoming requests, either `header`, `cookie`, or `query` parameter.

apiKeyName.description: The name of the header, query parameter, or cookie where you located the API key.

securitySchemeType.description: The type of security scheme implemented for the endpoint. The only valid value is `apikey`.

type.description: __Read-only__ The specification of the import file you uploaded to create the endpoint version. Either `SWAGGER` or `RAML`.

schema.description: Caching settings configured for an endpoint. Caching settings specify properties such as the maximum age of cached content, caching HTTP error responses, downstream cacheability, and cache key customization. You can set specific caching instructions for each resource within an endpoint version. You can configure caching settings if the API Gateway product is in your contract.

cacheKey.description: The cache key settings configured for an endpoint or resource.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize cache key settings for an endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

exactMatch.description: Whether the query parameters in the requests match exactly the string items in the corresponding `parameters`. When `false`, substrings match the start of the string. Relevant only if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

option.description: The configuration option to customize cache keys. You can `INCLUDE` only the specified set of `parameters` in the cache key, or set `IGNORE` to exclude them. `IGNORE_ALL` excludes all parameters from the cache key. Set `INCLUDE_ALL_PRESERVE_ORDER` to key on the full set of parameters in the request's order, or `INCLUDE_ALL_ALPHABETIZE_ORDER` to ignore the original order.

parameters.description: Parameters to include in or exclude from cache keys, depending on the `option` you selected. This is only relevant if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize caching behavior for the endpoint. This applies only to the main caching settings. You can set `customize` fields for `errorCaching`, `cacheKey` and `downstreamCaching` independently.

downstreamCaching.description: Downstream caching settings. Downstream caching refers to the caching instructions assigned to objects sent with responses toward clients, for example browsers, mobile devices, or client proxies.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize downstream caching behavior for the endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

headers.description: The policy for sending headers downstream, either `CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to send both `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers, `CACHE_CONTROL` to send only the `Cache-Control` header, `EXPIRES` to send only the `Expires` header, or `SAME_AS_ORIGIN` to send the same headers as your origin.

lifetime.description: The cache lifetime policy, either `SMALLER_VALUE` for a value smaller than specified in the origin header or the remaining edge TTL, `GREATER_VALUE` for a value greater than specified in the origin header or the remaining edge TTL, `REMAINING_EDGE_TTL` for a remaining edge TTL, `FULL_EDGE_TTL` for a full edge TTL, `FIXED_VALUE` for a value that you specify, or `CALCULATES_EXPIRES_FROM_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` for calculating the maximum age from the origin `Cache-Control` header.

markAsPrivate.description: Specifies whether to disallow storing responses in a shared cache. Use this when you want to set a maximum age for the end client, but have shared caches not store the response.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration to keep content in a cache.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

option.description: The option for downstream caching, either `ALLOW_CACHING` to allow downstream caching, `ALLOW_CACHING_REQUIRES_REVALIDATION` to allow downstream caching, but require origin revalidation, `NOT_ALLOW_CACHING` to disallow downstream caching, `PASS_CACHEABILITY_HEADERS_FROM_ORIGIN` to pass cacheability headers from your origin, or `DO_NOT_SEND_HEADERS` to disallow sending headers and apply browser defaults.

enabled.description: __Deprecated__ Delivery caching settings for the endpoint can be overridden by using four independent `customize` fields.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize error caching behavior for the endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

enabled.description: Defines how you want to cache error responses. A `true` value caches HTTP error responses according to the `maxAge` setting. A `false` value disables caching of HTTP error responses.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration to keep content in a cache.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

preserveStale.description: Whether to preserve stale responses when the origin is unreachable and content revalidation isn't possible.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration to keep content in a cache.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

option.description: The options for how to pass cached content, either `CACHE` to enable caching in Akamai platform servers according to the instructions you specify, `BYPASS_CACHE` to disallow caching in Akamai platform servers and keep the existing cache entries, `NO_STORE` to disallow caching in Akamai platform servers and remove the existing cache entries, `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` header, `HONOR_ORIGIN_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Expires` header, or `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers.

preRefreshing.description: Cache prefreshing settings. When enabled, edge servers asynchronously refresh cached objects after a specified percentage of the object's TTL elapses.

enabled.description: Whether you enable cache prefreshing.

value.description: With TTL the duration before cached content ordinarily refreshes, this refreshes content before then, expressed as a percentage of the TTL, from 0 to 99.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize cache key settings for an endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

exactMatch.description: Whether the query parameters in the requests match exactly the string items in the corresponding `parameters`. When `false`, substrings match the start of the string. Relevant only if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

option.description: The configuration option to customize cache keys. You can `INCLUDE` only the specified set of `parameters` in the cache key, or set `IGNORE` to exclude them. `IGNORE_ALL` excludes all parameters from the cache key. Set `INCLUDE_ALL_PRESERVE_ORDER` to key on the full set of parameters in the request's order, or `INCLUDE_ALL_ALPHABETIZE_ORDER` to ignore the original order.

parameters.description: Parameters to include in or exclude from cache keys, depending on the `option` you selected. This is only relevant if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

inheritsFromEndpoint.description: Whether the resource inherits the top-level API caching settings.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration of keeping content in a cache. If set, overwrites the max age instructions set at the endpoint level.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

methods.description: __Read-only__ The methods assigned to the resource, either `POST`, `GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, or `PATCH`.

option.description: The resource caching option, either `CACHE` to enable caching in Akamai platform servers according to the instructions you specify, `BYPASS_CACHE` to send requests straight to origin and disallow caching in downstream caches, `NO_STORE` to disallow caching in Akamai platform servers, `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` header, `HONOR_ORIGIN_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Expires` header, or `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers. If set, overwrites the caching instructions set at the endpoint level.

path.description: __Read-only__ The URL path relative to the hostnames on which the resource resides.

preRefreshing.description: Cache prefreshing settings. When enabled, edge servers asynchronously refresh cached objects after a specified percentage of the object's TTL elapses.

enabled.description: Whether you enable cache prefreshing.

value.description: With TTL the duration before cached content ordinarily refreshes, this refreshes content before then, expressed as a percentage of the TTL, from 0 to 99.

serveStale.description: Whether to serve stale objects when the origin is unreachable and content revalidation isn't possible.

resources.description: Caching settings for each resource assigned to an endpoint version. This object is a map where the keys are resource IDs and values are cache settings applied to them.

serveStale.description: Whether to serve stale responses when the origin is unreachable and content revalidation isn't possible.

200.description: Response data shows current cache settings.

You can set specific caching instructions for each resource within an endpoint version. You can configure caching settings if the API Gateway product is in your contract.

cacheKey.description: The cache key settings configured for an endpoint or resource.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize cache key settings for an endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

exactMatch.description: Whether the query parameters in the requests match exactly the string items in the corresponding `parameters`. When `false`, substrings match the start of the string. Relevant only if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

option.description: The configuration option to customize cache keys. You can `INCLUDE` only the specified set of `parameters` in the cache key, or set `IGNORE` to exclude them. `IGNORE_ALL` excludes all parameters from the cache key. Set `INCLUDE_ALL_PRESERVE_ORDER` to key on the full set of parameters in the request's order, or `INCLUDE_ALL_ALPHABETIZE_ORDER` to ignore the original order.

parameters.description: Parameters to include in or exclude from cache keys, depending on the `option` you selected. This is only relevant if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize caching behavior for the endpoint. This applies only to the main caching settings. You can set `customize` fields for `errorCaching`, `cacheKey` and `downstreamCaching` independently.

downstreamCaching.description: Downstream caching settings. Downstream caching refers to the caching instructions assigned to objects sent with responses toward clients, for example browsers, mobile devices, or client proxies.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize downstream caching behavior for the endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

headers.description: The policy for sending headers downstream, either `CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to send both `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers, `CACHE_CONTROL` to send only the `Cache-Control` header, `EXPIRES` to send only the `Expires` header, or `SAME_AS_ORIGIN` to send the same headers as your origin.

lifetime.description: The cache lifetime policy, either `SMALLER_VALUE` for a value smaller than specified in the origin header or the remaining edge TTL, `GREATER_VALUE` for a value greater than specified in the origin header or the remaining edge TTL, `REMAINING_EDGE_TTL` for a remaining edge TTL, `FULL_EDGE_TTL` for a full edge TTL, `FIXED_VALUE` for a value that you specify, or `CALCULATES_EXPIRES_FROM_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` for calculating the maximum age from the origin `Cache-Control` header.

markAsPrivate.description: Specifies whether to disallow storing responses in a shared cache. Use this when you want to set a maximum age for the end client, but have shared caches not store the response.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration to keep content in a cache.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

option.description: The option for downstream caching, either `ALLOW_CACHING` to allow downstream caching, `ALLOW_CACHING_REQUIRES_REVALIDATION` to allow downstream caching, but require origin revalidation, `NOT_ALLOW_CACHING` to disallow downstream caching, `PASS_CACHEABILITY_HEADERS_FROM_ORIGIN` to pass cacheability headers from your origin, or `DO_NOT_SEND_HEADERS` to disallow sending headers and apply browser defaults.

enabled.description: __Deprecated__ Delivery caching settings for the endpoint can be overridden by using four independent `customize` fields.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize error caching behavior for the endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

enabled.description: Defines how you want to cache error responses. A `true` value caches HTTP error responses according to the `maxAge` setting. A `false` value disables caching of HTTP error responses.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration to keep content in a cache.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

preserveStale.description: Whether to preserve stale responses when the origin is unreachable and content revalidation isn't possible.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

option.description: The options for how to pass cached content, either `CACHE` to enable caching in Akamai platform servers according to the instructions you specify, `BYPASS_CACHE` to disallow caching in Akamai platform servers and keep the existing cache entries, `NO_STORE` to disallow caching in Akamai platform servers and remove the existing cache entries, `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` header, `HONOR_ORIGIN_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Expires` header, or `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers.

preRefreshing.description: Cache prefreshing settings. When enabled, edge servers asynchronously refresh cached objects after a specified percentage of the object's TTL elapses.

enabled.description: Whether you enable cache prefreshing.

value.description: With TTL the duration before cached content ordinarily refreshes, this refreshes content before then, expressed as a percentage of the TTL, from 0 to 99.

customize.description: Whether you want to customize cache key settings for an endpoint. You can set this independently from the root `customize` field.

exactMatch.description: Whether the query parameters in the requests match exactly the string items in the corresponding `parameters`. When `false`, substrings match the start of the string. Relevant only if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

option.description: The configuration option to customize cache keys. parameters.description: Parameters to include in or exclude from cache keys, depending on the `option` you selected. This is only relevant if you set the corresponding `option` to either `INCLUDE` or `IGNORE`.

inheritsFromEndpoint.description: Whether the resource inherits the top-level API caching settings.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

methods.description: __Read-only__ The methods assigned to the resource, either `POST`, `GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, or `PATCH`.

option.description: The resource caching option, either `CACHE` to enable caching in Akamai platform servers according to the instructions you specify, `BYPASS_CACHE` to send requests straight to origin and disallow caching in downstream caches, `NO_STORE` to disallow caching in Akamai platform servers, `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` header, `HONOR_ORIGIN_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Expires` header, or `HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to apply caching instructions specified in your origin's `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers. If set, overwrites the caching instructions set at the endpoint level.

path.description: __Read-only__ The URL path relative to the hostnames on which the resource resides.

serveStale.description: Whether to serve stale objects when the origin is unreachable and content revalidation isn't possible.

schema.description: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) settings configured for an endpoint. CORS enables clients to request restricted resources from external domains outside the domain that served the first resource. You can configure CORS settings if the API Gateway product is in your contract.

allowCredentials.description: Whether you allow credentialed HTTP requests to access your resources. Credentials may be cookies or TLS client certificates.

allowedHeaders.description: The HTTP header names that you allow using the `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` header.

allowedMethods.description: The HTTP methods that you allow using the `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` header, either `GET`, `PUT`, `POST`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS`, `PATCH`, or `HEAD`.

allowedOrigins.description: The origin hostnames that you allow using the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header. The wildcard (`*`) means all hostnames.

enabled.description: Whether you enabled CORS for the endpoint.

exposedHeaders.description: The headers that you expose using the `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` header. By exposing a header, you allow clients to access it.

preflightMaxAge.description: The maximum time in seconds for caching responses to preflight requests.

200.description: Response data shows current CORS settings.

schema.description: Error response settings configured for an endpoint. If an inbound client request fails, API Gateway returns a default error response with a JSON-formatted description and a status code. You can customize the descriptions, status codes, and headers of selected error responses to help API consumers identify the cause of an error and troubleshoot effectively. downstreamCaching.description: Downstream caching settings. Downstream caching refers to the caching instructions assigned to objects sent with responses toward clients, for example browsers, mobile devices, or client proxies.

headers.description: The policy for sending headers downstream, either `CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES` to send both `Cache-Control` and `Expires` headers, `CACHE_CONTROL` to send only the `Cache-Control` header, `EXPIRES` to send only the `Expires` header, or `SAME_AS_ORIGIN` to send the same headers as your origin.

lifetime.description: The cache lifetime policy, either `SMALLER_VALUE` for a value smaller than specified in the origin header or the remaining edge TTL, `GREATER_VALUE` for a value greater than specified in the origin header or the remaining edge TTL, `REMAINING_EDGE_TTL` for a remaining edge TTL, `FULL_EDGE_TTL` for a full edge TTL, `FIXED_VALUE` for a value that you specify, or `CALCULATES_EXPIRES_FROM_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` for calculating the maximum age from the origin `Cache-Control` header.

maxAge.description: The maximum duration to keep content in a cache.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

option.description: The option for downstream caching, either `ALLOW_CACHING` to allow downstream caching, `ALLOW_CACHING_REQUIRES_REVALIDATION` to allow downstream caching, but require origin revalidation, `NOT_ALLOW_CACHING` to disallow downstream caching, `PASS_CACHEABILITY_HEADERS_FROM_ORIGIN` to pass cacheability headers from your origin, or `DO_NOT_SEND_HEADERS` to disallow sending headers and apply browser defaults.

schema.description: An incoming request's routing settings configured for an endpoint. Routing settings specify routing, forwarding, and SureRoute instructions for an endpoint version. You can configure routing settings if the API Gateway product is in your contract and you're taking part in the API Gateway beta program.

items.description: Criteria that identifies which incoming requests to process for an endpoint.

conditions.description: A set of criteria that determines the action the API takes when an incoming request for an endpoint meets the criteria.

operator.description: Compares the incoming request to the `type` and `value` fields. The API supports only `IS` as a value.

type.description: Specifies the query string value to match. Use `RESOURCE` to match on a resource like JSON or XML. Use `METHOD` to match on the request method in the request header. Use `HOSTNAME` to match on the hostname in the request's incoming `Host` header.

value.description: Specifies the string you're trying to match. For flexible URL path matching, use `*` and `?`.

customForwardPath.description: Specifies the request's new forward path when the `forwardPath` value is `CUSTOM_PATH`.

description.description: Descriptive text for the rule.

forwardHostHeader.description: Specifies the request's new host header.

forwardPath.description: Specifies the request's forward path mode, either `DEFAULT_PATH` or `CUSTOM_PATH`.

forwardPort.description: Specifies the request's new port number.

name.description: A unique identifier for the rule.

origin.description: Specifies the request's new origin server destination.

items.description: Specifies the SureRoute settings configured for an endpoint.

forceSslForward.description: Forces SureRoute to use SSL when requesting the test object from your alternate origin server. Set the value to `true` when the origin doesn't respond to HTTP requests or responds with a redirect to HTTPS.

origin.description: Specifies the origin server where the SureRoute definitions are applied.

raceKey.description: Specifies a custom key to store race results.

raceKeyMode.description: Specifies which hostname to use to store race results. Either `DEFAULT` for the race destination's hostname or `CUSTOM` for a custom hostname.

raceStatTtl.description: Specifies the TTL to hold the SureRoute race results. Races only run when certain thresholds exceed their limit. If traffic drops below the thresholds, the edge server continues to use the last race results to determine the optimal route until this TTL expires. When traffic next increases over the thresholds, the edge server uses the direct route until SureRoute determines a new optimal route.

duration.description: The maximum duration of content caching in the selected unit of time.

unit.description: The unit of time for content caching, either `SECONDS`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, or `DAYS`.

testObjectPath.description: Specifies the test object's path on your alternate origin server. SureRoute uses this path in races to test routes. For example, `/akamai/testobject.html`.

200.description: The response shows the current routing settings.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_DELETE.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the DELETE method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_GET.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the GET method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_HEAD.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources using HEAD method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_OPTIONS.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources using OPTIONS method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_PATCH.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources using PATCH method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_POST.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the POST method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_METHOD_PUT.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources using the PUT method. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows requesting with undefined parameters. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_QUERY_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows for requests with undefined parameters in query string. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_RESOURCES.description: Whether the API allows requests on undefined resources. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

ALLOW_UNDEFINED_SPEC_PARAMS.description: Whether the API allows requesting undefined resources, but only for specific locations. Either `1` or `0` for yes or no.

MAX_DOC_DEPTH.description: The maximum depth of nested data elements allowed in a request body.

MAX_ELEMENT_NAME_LENGTH.description: The maximum length of an XML element name or JSON object key name allowed in a request body.

MAX_INTEGER_VALUE.description: The maximum integer value allowed in a request body.

MAX_JSONXML_ELEMENT.description: The maximum number of XML elements, JSON object keys, or array items allowed in a request body.

lengthMin.description: The minimum allowed number of characters in the string.

numberRangeRestriction.description: Specify range restrictions on number parameters.

rangeRestriction.description: Specify range restrictions for integer parameters.

responseRestriction.description: The maximum allowed size of the response body.

maxBodySize.description: Specify the size limit of the response body. Choose `SIZE_6K` for 6KB, `SIZE_8K` for 8KB, `SIZE_12K` for 12KB, or `NO_LIMIT` to allow any response size.

statusCodes.description: Response status codes to be matched to the response. Specify `null` or leave empty to apply the definition to any response body.

xmlConversionRule.description: XML settings for the parameter.

attribute.description: Whether the parameter should be represented as an attribute.

name.description: The name of the parameter in XML. By default, the XML name is the same as the parameter name specified when you created the API definition.

prefix.description: The prefix for the XML namespace.

wrapped.description: Whether the parameter should be wrapped in a parent XML element.

apiParameterType.description: The data type of the parameter, either `string`, `integer`, `number`, `boolean` for cookies, headers, query string, and path parameters. For request body following types are supported: `json`, `xml`, or `json/xml` for either JSON or XML objects, or `urlencoded`.

apiResourceMethParamId.description: __Read-only__ The unique identifier for the parameter's parent method.

array.description: Whether the parameter can express more than one value. This field is only applicable for `apiChildParameters` that you can specify if the corresponding `apiParameterLocation` is `body` and the `apiParameterType` is `json/xml`. If you enable this, also define the `arrayRestriction` field.

arrayItemNullable.description: Indicates whether items in an array parameter can be `null`.

nullable.description: Indicates whether the parameter value can be `null`.

pathParamLocationId.description: The index of a segment that includes a path parameter in a resource path. For example, given a path `\books\{bookId}`, the `books` segment has index `0`, and the path parameter `{bookId}` has index `1`.

response.description: Whether the parameter belongs to the response.

apiResourceMethod.description: The core HTTP method to which the resource may respond, either `GET`, `PUT`, `POST`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`, `PATCH`, or `OPTIONS`.

apiResourceMethodId.description: The unique identifier for the resource's allowed method.

apiResourceMethodLogicId.description: The unique identifier for the resource's method across all endpoint versions.

methodRestrictions.description: Collects data for restrictions on the method level.

allowMethodUndefinedParameters.description: Specify whether undefined parameters are allowed, overriding the top-level setting for undefined parameters.

body.description: Whether undefined parameters are allowed in request body.

cookie.description: Whether undefined parameters are allowed in request cookies.

header.description: Whether undefined parameters are allowed in request headers.

query.description: Whether undefined parameters are allowed in request query string.

jsonRequestRejectDuplicates.description: Whether to reject duplicate JSON requests.

createDate.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when you created the resource.

createdBy.description: The identifier for the user who created the resource.

description.description: The description to clarify the resource's function within the API. If you specify `null` in the request or omit this field from the object, the JSON response reflects it as an empty string.

link.description: The location of the navigable resource within this API, for use by API clients. Don't include hostnames.

lockVersion.description: The identifier used for optimistic locking. See [Concurrency control](#concurrencycontrol) for details.

metadata.description: Information about the number of methods enabled, methods with assigned operations, and operations.

methodsEnabled.description: The number of methods enabled for the resource.

methodsWithOperations.description: The number of methods that have assigned operations.

operationCount.description: The total number of operations assigned to the resource.

private.description: Whether the resource is private. API consumers can access private resources only if they identify with an appropriate API key.

resourcePath.description: The resource's path, with the API base path omitted. For example, `/login`.

updateDate.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when you last modified the resource.

updatedBy.description: The identifier for the user who last modified the resource.

validation.description: Contains warnings, errors, or notices determined by validating the match target.

items.description: Contains feedback on validation.

detail.description: The explanation of the error message.

fieldName.description: The name of the field causing the validation problem.

jsonReference.description: The JSON reference to the field in the resource.

type.description: The URL for the error type.

fieldErrors.description: Pointers to fields with invalid input. Values are messages that explain why the input is invalid.
